Regulation Set M-C

The Regulation Set M-C of Pokémon Champions is the third official ruleset. Mega Evolutions are allowed. Regulation Set M-C is the official format of in-game Ranked Battles from 9 September to 2 December 2026.

Regulation Set M-D

The Regulation Set M-D of Pokémon Champions is the fourth official ruleset. Mega Evolutions are allowed. Regulation Set M-D is the official format of in-game Ranked Battles from 2 December 2026 to 3 March 2027.
